evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow for transferring reporting responsibility when a conflict arises — diverging from the normal main flow by introducing resolution mechanisms (J7 message, operator procedure, or voice) instead of automatic assumption via drop track report.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for a nonreal-time ballistic missile track will relinquish R² upon receiving a remote real-time track report for that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative flow where reporting responsibility is transferred (relinquished) due to the arrival of superior data (remote real-time track), diverging from the standard timeout or drop-track triggers.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² on a ballistic missile track if its local TQ at or before the time of the remote track time tag exceeds the received TQ by 1 or more.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative path for assuming reporting responsibility based on a specific quality threshold (TQ difference >= 1) rather than waiting for a drop message or timeout.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU is reporting 'Lost Track' data with a TQ of 15, a JU holding 'Tracking' data may assume R² with a TQ of 11 regardless of the time tag on the remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific exception/alternative scenario where R² assumption logic changes based on the 'Lost Track' status indicator and specific TQ values.

evidence_cards.content: The exception to the rule that each unit must assign a new TN is when a unit originates a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report on a Fix, AOP, or LOB currently reported by the same unit or received from another unit in a J14.0 message; in this case, it shall assign the same TN as contained in the J14.0 message.

source_locations.location: paragraph under section 4.4.7.2 ELECTRONIC WARFARE PRODUCT INFORMATION REPORTING RESPONSIBILITY

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative successful path for assigning track numbers during reporting responsibility transfer — specifically, reusing an existing TN instead of generating a new one — which constitutes a valid variant flow diverging from the main requirement to always assign a new TN.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU(s) that have originated surveillance amplification data on the track shall respond with the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative interaction path where the receiving unit responds to a request for more detailed surveillance data rather than assuming reporting responsibility immediately.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU controlling the TN shall transmit the appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management messages and J13 Platform and System Status messages to include the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message, the J10.2 Engagement Status message, and the appropriate J13 Platform and System Status messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative response flow for the controlling unit upon receiving a data update request, focusing on status reporting rather than track assumption.

evidence_cards.content: All C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific self-reporting alternative flow when the C2 JU receives a request regarding its own track number.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path where reporting responsibility transfer is attempted but results in a conflict (different TNs), leading to a rejection message (RV=1) rather than successful transfer.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a hard constraint/exception condition that prevents the standard correlation and reporting responsibility transfer logic from applying to subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs that have the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action shall also have the capability to deactivate this automatic capability.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a mandatory exception handling capability (deactivation of automation) required for C2 JUs when initiating tracks automatically, which is relevant to managing unexpected or erroneous automatic track generation.

evidence_cards.content: Nonreal-time data shall be identified as such and time tags shall be provided. Nonreal-time track positions shall not be extrapolated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific exception handling rules for non-real-time data: it must be flagged explicitly, tagged with time, and crucially, its position must NOT be extrapolated (a deviation from the standard real-time behavior).

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the persistence of reporting responsibility (R²) as an exception condition where transfer does not occur automatically without specific triggers (rules or drop).

evidence_cards.content: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific failure mode (missing termination message) that constitutes an exception flow requiring special handling (purging).

evidence_cards.content: If a J3.4 message containing the Track Number is not received for two consecutive periodic updates, the condition allowing another JU to report the contact using that track number is met, serving as an alternative trigger to the receipt of a J7.0 Drop Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception path for transferring or assuming reporting responsibility based on a timeout/missing update condition rather than an explicit drop message.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in ballistic missile position or velocity recognized by a JU are not resolved through conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1, Difference Report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an exception condition where standard conflict resolution (J7.0 Difference Report) is explicitly prohibited for specific data types (ballistic missile position/velocity), preventing the normal transfer flow.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception to the general assumption of responsibility rules; when R² is assumed for a ballistic missile track, the responsibility does not automatically extend to the associated launch point.

evidence_cards.content: If an Environment/Category conflict is detected during the processing of a Surveillance message or J7.0 (ACT = 1) Difference Report message, no further processing to detect an ID conflict need occur.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific exception handling path where the detection of one type of data conflict (Environment/Category) prevents the system from attempting to resolve another potential conflict (ID), altering the standard resolution flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a C² JU finds a correlation between received PPLI reports and local sensor data for a track where the C² JU has R², it shall transmit a J7.2 Correlation message with Response Value (RV) set to 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), retain the Source TN from the PPLI message, drop the surveillance TN, cease reporting the track, and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception flow where a correlation attempt results in a 'Not Acceptable' rejection response, triggering a subsequent Drop Track action rather than a standard assumption of responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are different, the receiving JU shall transmit a J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message, retaining the Source TN from the PPLI message as the Retained TN and designating the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow for handling conflicting Track Numbers during correlation, enforcing the retention of the PPLI source identity over the existing surveillance track identity.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the receiving JU shall generally disregard the J3 surveillance data; however, if the Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, the exception applies where the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message is discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a conditional exception flow based on data quality (Geodetic Position Quality = 0) that reverses the standard precedence rule, causing the system to reject the incoming PPLI update in favor of existing surveillance data.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where the standard termination message transmission is prohibited due to a state change (becoming an Active IU).

evidence_cards.content: If a JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message does not purge the point, line, or area, it shall assume R² for the entity to ensure that it remains active on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a recovery/continuation path where the receiving unit assumes reporting responsibility instead of terminating the track, ensuring continuity despite the drop request.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a terminal exception outcome (correlation failure) with specific timeout condition and system response (cancellation of processing), directly filling the exception_flow slot.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception recovery path: upon unexpected remote report of dropped track, system suppresses further correlation attempts for 60 seconds — a documented error-handling behavior relevant to exception_flow.

evidence_cards.content: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an exception condition where the standard Drop Track message is missing, triggering the need for a purge procedure.

evidence_cards.content: For a ballistic missile launch point, if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another IU may assume R² for the point by operator action only.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception condition (timeout of updates) that triggers a recovery path (operator-assisted assumption of R²), which fits the definition of exception_flow as it handles an unexpected or degraded state rather than the nominal transfer flow.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 0 or 1 shall not accept the requested correlation when local or remote data indicates a correlation restriction exists; in this case, the correlation shall be rejected.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition where correlation is explicitly rejected rather than accepted.

evidence_cards.content: If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 0, the reverse correlation shall be transmitted if the new Dropped TN has no correlation constraint; otherwise, the correlation shall be rejected.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies conditional rejection logic based on OCC status and RV field value.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2 minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Imposes a time-based restriction following a rejection event, preventing immediate retry.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the recovery action (operator alert/voice coordination) triggered by a specific rejection scenario.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 3 shall automatically accept the requested correlation unless one of the following restrictions applies: tracks are of different E/C, one track is simulated while the other is live, or both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Lists specific conditions under which even a manually initiated correlation (RV=3) results in rejection.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system response (message transmission and TN assignment) when a correlation conflict occurs due to differing Track Numbers between the incoming PPLI and existing surveillance data held by another unit.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R² and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0, in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path where standard data precedence rules are inverted based on the 'Geodetic Position Quality' value being 0, resulting in the rejection of the PPLI message.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a hard constraint/exception preventing correlation logic from executing for specific entity types (subsurface tracks vs Interface Units).

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition that prevents the automatic correlation step required for transferring reporting responsibility, constituting an exception flow path.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a correlation restriction based on Mode II codes that blocks the standard transfer process.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Prevents automatic correlation of redundant local tracks, serving as an exception to the normal correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: If either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, C² JUs shall not inhibit correlation unless the Strength is set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies that high Strength values do not trigger the correlation inhibition exception, defining the boundary of this exception flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the received J2.2 or J2.3 Qpg = 0, the PPLI shall not be correlated automatically.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a specific data quality threshold (Qpg=0) that triggers an exception where automatic correlation is prohibited.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an explicit exception flow where correlation fails due to timeout, resulting in cancellation of processing — directly addresses error handling path for missing response message.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes recovery/continuation behavior after suppression of re-correlation — specifies that the system retains the track remotely and enforces a 60-second suppression window, which constitutes a defined exception handling path with temporal constraint.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint preventing reporting of TQ values exceeding local geodetic accuracy; this acts as a validation failure condition for track reporting eligibility during transfer scenarios.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not artificially increase TQ between sensor inputs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a prohibition against artificial TQ inflation, serving as a constraint on data manipulation during correlation or assumption of reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 0 or 1 shall not accept the requested correlation when local or remote data indicates that the Retained TN and Dropped TN will decorrelate once subjected to decorrelation criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where the system rejects a correlation request due to predicted track decorrelation.

evidence_cards.content: If there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and the received RV field is set to value 0, the reverse correlation shall be transmitted if the new Dropped TN has no correlation constraint; if both the Retained TN and Dropped TN have an OCC, the correlation shall be rejected.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the exception path for handling Operator Control Constraints (OCC) leading to either a reverse correlation request or a rejection.

evidence_cards.content: Whenever a correlation request is rejected, the J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 shall be transmitted to report the rejection.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the mandatory system response (message transmission) when an exception (rejection) occurs.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 2 (Correlation Rejection) shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2(1-10,1) minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the recovery/continuation constraint following an exception event to prevent infinite rejection loops.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, and the Dropped TN has an OCC with RV set to 1, the JU shall transmit a correlation rejection with RV set to 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details a specific exception branch based on track ownership status and constraint flags.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 3 shall automatically accept the requested correlation unless restrictions apply, such as the two tracks being of a different E/C, one track being simulated while the other is live, or both tracks being locally derived real-time tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Lists specific exception conditions that override the default acceptance of manually initiated correlations.

evidence_cards.content: The latest JU to report a point has R² for that point.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines the postcondition state after successful transfer: reporting responsibility (R²) is held by the most recent reporting unit.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assuming R² for an emergency point shall use the same TN Reference and the same value of TN Previously Reported as those reported by the previous reporting unit.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies data continuity requirement in postcondition — the new responsible JU must retain track numbering context from prior holder, ensuring system state consistency after transfer.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of the system after a successful transfer: the new holder retains responsibility until specific conditions are met, establishing the postcondition of 'responsibility held'.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R², except in cases where it has relinquished R² to another JU or the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms that upon successful transfer (relinquishment), the originating JU ceases reporting and does not transmit a Drop Track message, marking the end of its responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: After the C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message for an inactive Interface Unit (IU), the IU returns to the interface as an Active IU, and the JU holding R² ceases reporting the IU without transmitting a new J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state and action cessation that occurs after a transfer or reactivation scenario involving an inactive IU, satisfying the postcondition requirement for system state after completion.

evidence_cards.content: If a Track Number (TN) has been previously reported on an Interface Unit (IU) using an address other than the IU's address, the J7.2 message may be used to resolve the dual designation to the IU's address.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final resolution state of track designations (dual designation resolved to IU address) following the transfer/reactivation process.

evidence_cards.content: The JU assuming R² retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the duration of the post-transfer state for the receiving JU.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific postcondition regarding the separation of reporting responsibilities between the track and its launch point.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0 Drop Track message, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow path where the transfer process is suspended due to external reporting activity, requiring specific retention and suppression behaviors.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a timeout-based exception flow resulting in cancellation of the correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: If a selection conflict occurs due to OCCs on both the Retained TN and the Dropped TN during dual designation determination, the correlation shall be abandoned until the next correlation check.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where automatic correlation is halted due to conflicting constraints (OCC) on both tracks involved in the transfer/correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs receiving a J7.2 message with RV field set to value 0 or 1 shall not accept the requested correlation when local or remote data indicates: (1) a correlation restriction exists; (2) the tracks would decorrelate immediately; (3) there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and received RV is 0; or (4) there is an OCC on the Dropped TN and received RV is 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies conditions under which a receiving JU must reject a correlation request, constituting an exception path to the successful transfer/merge of track data.

evidence_cards.content: When a correlation request is rejected (RV=2), the originating JU shall not automatically originate a request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2(1-10,1) minutes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system response and suppression timer following a rejection exception, preventing immediate re-attempt of a failed correlation.

evidence_cards.content: C² JUs receiving a J7.2 message with RV field set to value 3 (manually initiated) shall automatically accept the correlation unless: (1) the tracks are of different E/C or have an existing E/C conflict; (2) one track is simulated and the other is live; or (3) both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Outlines specific exceptions where even a manually initiated correlation (which usually overrides automatic checks) must be rejected due to fundamental track incompatibilities.

evidence_cards.content: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, and the Dropped TN has an OCC, the system shall transmit a reverse correlation (if RV=0) or a correlation rejection (if RV=1).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path for asymmetric track ownership scenarios where specific constraints (OCC) dictate a reversal or rejection rather than standard acceptance.
